name: B10-0029/2024 (The Left) – Continued financial and military support to Ukraine by EU Member States
title: Resolution on continued financial and military support to Ukraine by EU Member States
part_text:
This text is a motion for a resolution from the Left Group. It does not change any law. It calls for diplomatic efforts to end the war in Ukraine, a peace conference, and a ceasefire. It asks Russia to withdraw its troops. It also opposes lifting restrictions on weapons use inside Russia and criticises EU military support. It raises concerns about corruption in Ukraine and the effects of the war on women and the environment.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. It is a set of demands and opinions, not a law.
- **Who it affects:** EU governments, Ukraine, Russia, and people affected by the war.
- **What happens next:** Parliament may vote on it. If passed, it is a non-binding position.
